item.title: How to Build a Custom Bookkeeping App with Claude Cowork
item.description: Most paid bookkeeping tools charge a monthly fee for something a freelancer’s data barely uses: multi-user accounts, invoicing modules, integrations you’ll never touch. This guide shows you how to build a bookkeeping app with Claude Cowork instead — a free, custom app with Next.js and Google Sheets as the database, deployed on Vercel, and locked behind a PIN so only you can use it. You don’t need to be a developer. You need a few free accounts, an hour of focused setup, and Claude Cowork doing the actual coding.

item.title: Claude Cowork Safety: Permissions, Modes and What to Avoid
item.description: Claude Cowork is Anthropic’s agentic feature that lets Claude act directly on your computer — reading and writing files, navigating your browser, and interacting with connected apps. That capability is genuinely useful, but it also means Claude can make changes that are difficult to undo. This guide covers Claude Cowork safety: which permissions to grant, which modes to use for which tasks, and the configurations that introduce the most risk.
